The '''Huntsman''' was a soundless [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapon]] produced by [[LaserHone/Legends|LaserHone]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ETU" />
